adopt: Run one command through the decision point and read back allow, deny with the lane to use instead, or needs-owner with the reason.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
An agent host's own permission prompt and a platform's governance end up as two authorities, and the weaker one wins: the operator answers a dialog the platform never saw, while the platform's rules sit in a document nothing enforces. What a denial cannot say is WHY, and an approval leaves no signed record that it happened.

Install
pip install awgov

Commands
  awgov

Quick start
  `load_policy(path=None)` reads `AWGOV_POLICY`, else the repo's
  the sanction file `agent_policy.yaml`, else a built-in **deny floor** (reads only),
  and caches by mtime.
  
  ## Parsing, not pattern matching
  
  A command is split into steps on unquoted separators, `$(...)` substitutions are
  parsed as their own commands, and every step is resolved through `env`, `sudo`,
  `wsl -d X -u root --`, `nsenter`, `bash -c`, `pwsh -Command` and `cmd /c` before
  it is classified on the resolved argv. `rg -n "rm -rf.git".claude/hooks` is a
  read; the text it searches for is data, never a verb.
  
  ## CLI

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awgov/
synopsis: One policy decision for every agent tool call -- allow, deny with the lane to use, or needs-owner.
